messages:
emily-pmm: Heads-up — NimbusGrid case study ready for final pass. Need: 1) a single short quote cleared for press, 2) legal signoff on the throughput claim, 3) timeline for localization (EN/FR). Draft here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/NimbusGridCase (wip). Can we finalize by EOD Thu?

raj: Happy to pull a tidy quote. I talked to their Head of ML — they want a sentence that highlights reliability more than raw numbers. Theyre also open to a call if that makes getting a quote faster.

claire-prod: I can coordinate a 20m interview. Availability Thu 1pm PT or Fri morning. If we record, we can clip a short soundbite for the launch post. Also flagging: PR wants a single-line embargo date so managers can prep.

emily-pmm: Lets do Thu 1pm PT. Claire, lock that and add recording slot. Raj, add two quote variants: one reliability-first, one numbers-first.

raj: Dropping drafts into the doc now. Variants:
```
Reliability-first: "Since moving to Redwood, NimbusGrids inference pipeline has stayed online during peak loads, letting us serve customers consistently without firefights."
Numbers-first: "We cut tail-latency by ~35% in production and improved token throughput, freeing up capacity for new features."
```
Marked both as "for legal review".

nate-legal: Quick guidance: reliability claims ok. For numeric claims change "~35%" -> "approximately 35%" and add parenthetical citation: "(internal performance tests, Sep 2025)". Also need a link to the benchmark appendix in the doc. I can do a 24h turnaround if nothing else is contested.

emily-pmm: Customer prefers the reliability-first quote but will accept the numbers variant with your edits. Theyre asking for an embargo until their earnings call on 2025-10-30. Can we honor that?

nate-legal: Embargo requested noted. Please confirm internal stakeholders (PR + sales) accept the embargo window; also confirm the appendix link before signoff.

sales-ops: We can accept embargo but need the final push date to align with lead routing cadence. If embargo holds until 10/30, please schedule the campaign to route inbound leads to the enterprise SDRs starting 10/31 0900 PT. Also request: include a short field playbook (2 bullet points) for SDRs in the doc.

claire-prod: Recording booked: Thu 2025-10-23 13:00 PT, 20m. Invites to emily-pmm, raj, nimbus-contact@example.com. Calendar event includes note: "embargo until 2025-10-30". :white_check_mark:

emily-pmm: Perfect. Raj — can you insert the benchmark appendix link and the edited numbers version? Nate, once you do the redline, feel free to mark the quote "legal-approved" in the doc.

raj: Appendix link added: internal://benchmarks/nimbusgrid-oct2025. Edited numbers variant: "We reduced tail-latency by approximately 35% in production (internal performance tests, Sep 2025), enabling higher sustained throughput without scaling infra."

nate-legal: Redlines applied: swapped "tail-latency" -> "99th-percentile latency", tightened phrasing. Final approved quote (legal):
```
"Since moving to Redwood, NimbusGrids inference pipeline achieved a reduction in 99th-percentile latency and enabled higher sustained throughput without additional infrastructure (internal performance tests, Sep 2025)."
```
Marked as legal-approved in the doc.

emily-pmm: Customer confirmed theyre OK with legals final language and the embargo. They asked that the launch post also include a single screenshot of the dashboard — Claire, can ops provide that?

claire-prod: Ops can export a sanitized dashboard screenshot tomorrow. Will add to the assets folder and add caption text.

sales-ops: Noted for routing: campaign will start 2025-10-31 09:00 PT and route to Enterprise SDR queue. Please include two headline variants for A/B test in the doc and a 1-paragraph elevator pitch for SDRs.

emily-pmm: Raj will drop headline variants and the SDR pitch by EOD. After that, were set to hand off to PR for scheduling and to Growth for A/B. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
